privacy: Projection only. No cookies, authorization, account identity, user_id, session_id, or full telemetry payload retained.

trace_runtime.action: Authenticated browser session opened the deployed Jeter page and clicked the existing Slow scenario once.

tempo.result: Frontend client span and backend server span share the trace ID; backend parent span ID equals frontend span ID.

trace_runtime.limitations: Grafana UI showed the frontend span ID but not a backend parent-span field in the opened detail. The parent equality is therefore represented as an evidence comparison diagram based on the authenticated Tempo runtime API projection, not as a fabricated UI screenshot.

error_runtime.action: Scheduled one controlled uncaught stage-demo Error; it changed no business data and used a unique marker.

browser.console: Chrome Console showed an Uncaught Error with the exact marker.
browser.payload_observation: The same marker appeared in the Faro exceptions[] payload.

grafana.result_observation: The matching exception row contains the same marker, kind=exception, and level=error.

error_runtime.limitations: HTTP 202 proves receiver acceptance only. The exact record-specific Collector receive/export hop was not separately observed; the downstream Loki result is independently verified. The Loki screenshot is cropped before user/session fields and the raw log is not retained.
